notes.title: Changelog 12/23/18
notes.content:
[b]Changelog 12/23/18[/b]
-You can now reference %count% in <loop> elements
-Upgraded to a newer version of electron, should make the whole program more stable
-In-app HTML Editor now available
-Fixed an issue where you couldn't add elements to actors
-Fixed an issue where players could access restricted character sheets if other players were impersonating them

notes.title: Changelog 10/1/18
notes.content:
-Re-added layer controls to map menu
-Re-added Player vision to the map menu
-Fixed an issue where maps would be locked at 0x0, only showing the background color of the map
-Fixed an issue where workshop mods like "calendar" wouldn't display
-Fixed an issue where the left-right panels would appear when windows are resized
-fixed an issue where the systembuilder would show the player bar when mousing over the bottom tabs
-Added a compression algorithm in an attempt to speed up loading times for players with slow internet
-Re-added setting controls

notes.title: Change log 9/30/2018
notes.content:
-Total Redesign of the main UI
-Tokens can no longer have infinite sight, you must assign a sight radius to reveal areas in FOW
-Fixed an issue where maps weren't loading properly on world load
-Fixed an issue where clicking a hyperlink in chat would direct you to the image, with no way back

notes.title: UI Changes and Bug fixes coming!
notes.content:
Hey all,

I've got a fresh UI overhaul coming in, and it feelz like a well needed improvement to the current one. Also hold tight because I have some bug fixes coming for maps and more!

Just wanted to give you all a heads up since its been a while since the last update and as always be sure to join the discord! (https://discord.gg/usy4ByN)

notes.title: Change Log 8/13/2018

notes.title: Change Log 8/5/2018
notes.content:
-'cond' attributes are evaluated as macros by default now
-Media player now accepts direct youtube links

notes.title: The big one! Change log 7/29/2018
notes.content:
-Fixed ALL GM Only tabs showing up when a player was forced to a single GM Only tab
-Fixed an issue where access menus wouldn't appear for players
-Fixed an issue where math was hidden was in the math menus
-Fixed an issue where the quick edit token menu was draggable
-Added an Inline initiative assignment button for combat
-During Combat players do not see `hidden` assets unless they have access to them
-HTML Sheets now available, making interactive sheets much easier to style and make visually appealing
-HTML pages now use the new HTML Format
-Slight visual tweaks to try and 'soften' the harshness of the ui
-Files dragged out of the file browser now network properly to connected clients
-v2 templates support summaries and mobile sheets
-Image files are now larger in the files tab, to help with drag and drop building
-Tags are purely used as organizational tools, and system specific tags have been moved to "Flags"
-Searching by tag is no longer case sensitive
-Talents and Special Rules are no longer supported in the compendiums, but new 'element types' are now supported.
-System builder upgraded to support v2 templates
-ngrok support built in as the default connection option (Port forwarding and UPnP are now in the options/mods menu)
-Alerts are more minimalistic and have a bounce animation added to them, hopefully to be less of an eye sore
-New actor types are now support in v2 templates
-Free Drawing is now available in the draw section of the tool
-Fixed an issue where text would be selected at random and dragging on the map would cause issues with dragging selected text
-Added Exploding and Re-rolling dice syntax to the macros
-Added Hex grids
-Width & Height can be adjusted per actor/element types (in your game.templates.display)

notes.title: GM Forge - Released!
notes.content:
Crazy to think about it, but we are now fully released! Its been quite the ride, and I want to say thank you for all the support and interest all of you have taken over the last year, this project would've died long ago without your critique and feedback!  
  
But I'm sure some of you are wondering... where do we go from here? What do you plan to do now?  
  
Well its simple... We're moving forward! One of things I have come to terms with is that I won't be able to build every system out there, so you may have noticed over the last two months how I have re-evaluated my priorities, focusing on mods and opening up the tool to user driven development, which I believe to be a ESSENTIAL part of any of a successful VTT.   
  
I believe I'll be a much better asset to the project by focusing all my developing efforts into solving bugs, documenting, encouraging and collaborating with the community to create powerful mods and systems for your favorite tabletop games.  
   
Any future 'New Features' I write will be driven by our [discord community](https://discord.gg/usy4ByN), which we have now setup a 'Voting Channel' where users can vote on which features they'd like to see, and I'll be implementing the most popular features, all suggested and voted on by our community.
